messages:
maddie: Heads-up: final prep for Apr26 webinar (Wed 10am PT). Need X + LinkedIn copy, 2 GIFs, LP with UTM, and SDR routing rules by EOD tomorrow. Who can pick up which piece?
ryan: I can handle copy—3 X variants (short, long, thread opener) + 2 LinkedIn variations (dev and enterprise tone). Will need the hero GIFs and final LP URL to add UTMs. ETA noon tomorrow.
nana: I'll take seedlist and inbound routing. Planning to split seed by company size and product interest. Will also set up watched-duration MQL flag.
joel: Design — I'll export two GIF concepts (animated chart, product-focus loop). I'll put 1200x675 and compressed X-safe 1MB versions in the design-assets folder. Targeting 5pm PT today.
ryan: For the copy, do we want a benchmark line in the opener? Proposing an A/B: one headline with explicit numbers, one with a qualitative lead.
maddie: Use the benchmark but avoid definitive percent claims without docs. Suggested phrasing: "See multi-fold latency improvements and tangible cost reductions in production." Legal wants the underlying eval linked.
ryan: Ok will do A/B: (A) "23x latency on real workloads" (B) "multi-fold latency improvements; measurable cost savings". I'll tag legal and include the eval folder.
maria-legal: @ryan send the benchmark data and the exact prompt + dataset used. We'll aim for 48h review, faster if files are complete. If claims are reproducible and traced, we'll sign off.
ryan: Shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz "webinar_benchmarks_apr26.xlsx" + "bench_eval_prompt.txt".
nana: Routing notes: Zapier form -> SFDC. Rule draft: company_size>100 -> enterprise_sdr_queue; watch_time>50% -> priority follow; visited_pricing_page -> flag. Will push to SDR handbook.
maddie: @devops can you stand up the webhook endpoint + add secret to Secrets Manager? Need path and token so Nana can wire Zapier.
devops: Yep. I'll create /webhooks/webinar-signup with bearer secret stored in vault. Will post path + env var name here once done. ETA EOD today.
social-bot: Recommend posting cadence for webinar day: pre (9:50am PT), start (10:05am PT), mid (10:30am PT), post (11:00am PT). Also suggests 2 thread variations for X to maximize reach.
joel: GIFs uploaded: https://redwood-assets/designs/webinar_gifs. Files: webinar_chart_1mb.gif, webinar_loop_1200x675.gif. Alt text added to file metadata: "Chart animation showing throughput and latency improvement".
ryan: Thx. I'll include alt text and produce one-thread-format + two single-tweet variants. Also adding example UTMs: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26&utm_content=variantA
maddie: Checklist for tomorrow EOD: 1) Copy in scheduler doc; 2) GIFs in assets; 3) LP live with UTM; 4) Webhook + secret configured; 5) SDR routing rules documented. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
nana: 705 I finished routing doc draft and seed segmentation. Will post seedlist to the scheduler by AM.
ryan: 705 Copy in scheduler doc + UTMs added. Pinging legal in the doc for inline comments.
joel: 705 1MB GIF and 1200x675 uploaded, added compressed PNG fallback for LinkedIn.
maria-legal: Starting review now. Quick note: please include the baseline config and workload description in the spreadsheet so we can verify claim context.
ryan: Added baseline section to the spreadsheet (latency metric definition, workload traces link).
nana: Zapier mapping after webhook posted. Will map fields: name, email, company, company_size, interest, utm_campaign, watch_time.
devops: Webhook created: /webhooks/webinar-signup, env var WEBINAR_SIGNUP_SECRET created in vault. Sharing internal doc: https://internal.devops/docs/webhooks#webinar.
maddie: Perfect. Final minor asks: Ryan please prepare two headline variants for the scheduler (explicit numbers and qualitative). Joel please confirm compressed sizes for X. Nana confirm SDR triage rules posted.
ryan: Will add the two headline variants and mark them in the scheduler doc.
joel: Compressed GIF is under 1MB for X, PNG fallback <300KB for LinkedIn.
nana: Routing rules posted to SDR handbook and linked in scheduler doc.
maria-legal: If no surprises in the eval files, plan to clear the copy by tomorrow EOD.
social-bot: Scheduler draft saved: https://scheduler.redwood/webinars/18765. Remember to set posting org account and alt text fields.
maddie: Thanks team — I'll run final scheduler tomorrow AM and confirm live post times. If anything blocks, drop it here. :thumbsup:
